caption: The App Store says Free to install. Free trial available. That is true only for the install; the app itself has no free plan; the store avatar is hidden.
Inside the app the cheapest plan is Kickstart Koala at $12.99 a month for up to $1,000 of offer revenue; all three plans start with a 14 day trial; the store name is hidden.
The FAQ confirms the free use is limited to development stores; on a live store you have to pick a paid plan; the store name and a reviewer's name are hidden.
After approval the app greets you with a Setup guide at 0 of 3 and App status Inactive: the plan is active but nothing shows on the storefront yet; the store name is hidden.
Our first offer, a quantity break, reads Not visible next to a Great job, your offer is live! card, because the theme embed was still off; the store name is hidden.
Billing after approval: Kickstart Koala selected, trial to 1 Dec 2026, $0.00 of $1,000 offer revenue used, and no cancel button on this screen; the store name is hidden.
The FAQ on cancelling: free inside the 14 day trial, after that downgrades are prorated but cancellations are not, and refunds go through support; the store name and a reviewer's name are hidden.
